summary.text: Tyler Sirois represents District 31 in the Florida House of Representatives, first elected in 2018, according to the House's official biography.

paragraphs.text: The profile lists Sirois as a resident of Merritt Island who was born in Cape Canaveral, studied at Florida State University (2006), and works as a vice president for external affairs and strategic initiatives.

sources.title: Tyler I. Sirois's official House profile
